s: Under Dr NTR Vaidya Seva, which of the following correctly describes the income eligibility and annual coverage?
o: Only BPL families, with coverage of ₹5 lakh per family per year
All families irrespective of income, with coverage of ₹25 lakh per family per year
Families with income up to ₹2 lakh and coverage of ₹10 lakh per family
BPL families and families with income up to ₹5 lakh, with coverage of ₹25 lakh per family per year
x: Dr NTR Vaidya Seva covers BPL families and families with annual income up to ₹5 lakh, providing cover of ₹25 lakh per family per year.
tq: Split the options by checking both the income ceiling and the coverage amount.

s:
With reference to Dr NTR Vaidya Seva, consider the following statements:
1. There is no limit on the annual cover for cancer treatment.
2. The scheme covers 3,257 procedures.
3. It benefited 1.43 crore families according to APSES 2024-25.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
x: All three statements are correct: cancer treatment has no cover limit, 3,257 procedures are covered, and 1.43 crore families benefited according to APSES 2024-25.
tq: Use the numerical cluster and verify each statement independently.

s: During June–December 2025, Dr NTR Vaidya Seva recorded which of the following figures?
o: 1.43 crore patients treated and ₹2,723 crore in claims
11.36 lakh patients treated and ₹2,723 crore in claims
9.22 lakh patients treated and ₹4,000 crore in claims
11.36 lakh patients treated and ₹9,668 crore in claims
x: During June–December 2025, 11.36 lakh patients were treated and claims amounted to ₹2,723 crore.
tq: Match the period with its treatment and claims figures.

s: In March 2026, which addition was made to Dr NTR Vaidya Seva?
x: Five cardiac procedures were added to Dr NTR Vaidya Seva in March 2026.
tq: Test the specific service addition rather than the broader scheme coverage.

s: The Universal Health Policy announced in 2026 provides free treatment up to which amount per citizen through insurers?
x: The Universal Health Policy provides free treatment up to ₹2.5 lakh per citizen through insurers.
tq: Separate the individual limit under the Universal Health Policy from the higher Vaidya Seva limit.

s: Under the Universal Health Policy, which institution covers poor persons beyond the insurer-provided limit?
o: The Dr NTR Vaidya Seva Trust
x: The Dr NTR Vaidya Seva Trust covers poor persons beyond ₹2.5 lakh, up to ₹25 lakh.
tq: Use the ‘who covers the excess’ approach to distinguish institutions.

s: Which one of the following correctly represents the rural and urban Primary Health Centre network in Andhra Pradesh according to SES 2025-26?
x: The network comprised 1,293 rural PHCs and 559 urban PHCs.
tq: Check the rural–urban labels instead of merely recognising the numbers.

s:
Consider the following statements about the health facility network in Andhra Pradesh:
1. There were 10,032 Village Health Clinics.
2. There were 11,086 sub-centres.
3. There were 173 Community Health Centres and 54 area hospitals.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
x: All three statements correctly state the reported numbers of Village Health Clinics, sub-centres, CHCs and area hospitals.
tq: Group the facility figures and verify each category separately.

s: The Family Physician concept in Andhra Pradesh envisages that PHC doctors should:
o: Manage only private hospitals in villages
Visit village health clinics on fixed days
x: Under the Family Physician concept, PHC doctors visit village health clinics on fixed days.
tq: Identify the operational meaning of the service concept.

s:
Which of the following statements regarding emergency and mobile health services in Andhra Pradesh is correct?
1. The State had 768 ambulances under the 108 service.
2. These ambulances carried 9.22 lakh patients in 2024-25.
3. The State also had 104 Mobile Medical Units.
x: The 108 service had 768 ambulances, carried 9.22 lakh patients in 2024-25, and operated alongside 104 Mobile Medical Units.
tq: Combine service count, outcome count and facility count without swapping them.

s: Under Citizen Health Screening, the 104 Mobile Medical Units now conduct how many tests a year?
x: The 104 Mobile Medical Units conduct 47 tests a year under Citizen Health Screening.
tq: Distinguish the number of tests from the service number and facility counts.

s:
Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
1. Dr YSR Kanti Velugu — Eye health
2. Nadu-Nedu — School education
3. YSR Nethanna Nestham — Handloom weavers
x: Dr YSR Kanti Velugu concerns eye health, Nadu-Nedu concerns school education, and YSR Nethanna Nestham benefits handloom weavers.

s: Telemedicine in Andhra Pradesh is associated with which of the following facilities?
x: Telemedicine is associated with Ayushman Bharat Health and Wellness Centres, or AB-HWCs.
tq: Identify the facility-based application rather than the implementing scheme’s general objective.

s: Talliki Vandanam, earlier known as Amma Vodi, provides which benefit?
o: ₹15,000 per student as a one-time scholarship
₹10,090 per child per year to the school
₹15,000 per child per year to the mother

tq: Distinguish the beneficiary, periodicity and amount of the education benefit.

s: Talliki Vandanam was allocated ₹10,090 crore for how many students according to the reported January 2026 information?
x: An allocation of ₹10,090 crore was reported for 67.27 lakh students under Talliki Vandanam.
tq: Match the scheme allocation with its beneficiary count, not with figures from other education schemes.

s: Which one of the following is correctly matched with Mana Badi Mana Bhavishyathu (Nadu-Nedu)?
x: Mana Badi Mana Bhavishyathu, also called Nadu-Nedu, focuses on school infrastructure.
tq: Use objective-based discrimination among similarly named education schemes.

s:
Which of the following statements about Nadu-Nedu is correct?
1. ₹1,500 crore was provided for 2026-27.
2. Nadu-Nedu works worth ₹7,876 crore were left incomplete.
x: Both statements are correct: the 2026-27 provision was ₹1,500 crore and incomplete works were valued at ₹7,876 crore.
tq: Check whether the budget figure and implementation-status figure refer to the same scheme.

s:
Dokka Seethamma Madhyahna Bhojanam, formerly Jagananna Gorumudda, is characterised by which of the following?

Meals consisting of eggs and chikkis

s: The objective of Akshara Andhra, implemented through the Adult Education Department, is:
x: Akshara Andhra aims at 100% literacy.
tq: Match the programme with its stated objective rather than its department alone.

s: How many adults passed the FLNAT 2026 test under Akshara Andhra?
x: A total of 24.7 lakh adults passed the FLNAT 2026 test under Akshara Andhra.
tq: Carefully retain the decimal placement in the lakh figure.

s:
Consider the following statements regarding Samagra Shiksha in Andhra Pradesh:
1. There are 352 KGBVs.
2. Seats in KGBVs are allocated 75% to SC, ST, OBC and minority students and 25% to BPL students.
3. There are 679 Bhavitha centres for children with special needs.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
x: All three statements are correct. Samagra Shiksha includes 352 KGBVs, the stated 75:25 seat distribution, and 679 Bhavitha centres.
tq: Check both composition percentages and facility counts before selecting the coded option.

s: Which programme provides one full meal to pregnant and lactating women at Anganwadis?
o: Poshana Plus exclusively for tribal children
x: Anna Amrutha Hastam provides one full meal to pregnant and lactating women at Anganwadis.
tq: Identify the target group and service together.

o: Only school-going children aged 6 to 14 years
Only adolescent girls in urban areas
Only elderly persons below the poverty line
Pregnant and lactating women and children aged 6 months to 6 years, with Plus operating in tribal areas

tq: Use the age band and the tribal-area distinction to eliminate partial matches.

s: Balasanjeevani SNP currently covers approximately:
o: 4.15 lakh adolescent girls and 19.13 lakh school children
19.13 lakh pregnant/lactating women and 4.15 lakh children under six

1.31 crore women and 4.15 lakh children under six
x: Balasanjeevani SNP covers 4.15 lakh pregnant and lactating women and 19.13 lakh children under six.

s: Anna Canteens are primarily intended for the:

s: Which of the following correctly describes the Anna Canteen network?

s:

s:

Hospitals halted services over unpaid dues of ₹3,000 crore, and the opposition called the insurance model a dilution of Aarogyasri.
